items.name: XLsn0wAMapShowStation
items.description: 地图找房-高德地图显示数据点 - 按比例尺缩放显示数目---> (1.发起请求传给后台当前用户坐标。 2.让后台按用户位置将周边一定范围内（后台可调）的排序，返回。 3.前端请求到数据后，最近的电站数据在数组第一个，此时调用地图API的showAnnotations方法，显示用户位置和最近的房源大头针AnnotationView)--->XLsn0wKit--->(https://github.com/XLsn0w/XLsn0wKit_objc)

items.description: An alternative tool for writing scripts for mapping, typically using Google Docs. This is designed to make the process easier and less boring, with features to easily select the speaking nation, display its flag, set a custom background, and access other helpful options.
